texts.en: There is no such thing as a moral or an immoral book. Books are well written, or badly written. That is all.

refs: First book edition (London: Ward, Lock & Co., 1891), p. vi

texts.en: The moral life of man forms part of the subject-matter of the artist, but the morality of art consists in the perfect use of an imperfect medium.

refs: First book edition (London: Ward, Lock & Co., 1891), p. vi
